title: Round26 eight-direction walking build with 64 source-based frames
summary: Built eight distinct walk poses each for S SW W NW N NE E SE using original raster materials, articulated fixed-length guides and counter-swing. Corrected calf/cuff continuity, source fragments, frame margins and diagonal loop contact drift through five revisions. Tests verify 64 unique direction-local poses, connected boots/wrists, opaque boot toe contacts with zero tested loop support drift, matching atlas crops and exact independent decode of a 19-layer 64-frame ASE with eight walk tags. Four approved static source hashes unchanged. These are source-based rig frames, not 64 independent paintings. Founder visual approval, joint-edge polish, secondary cloth, native editor and Android acceptance remain open. Engine phase must use the supplied projected motion contract. No engine changes or private artwork published.
